Title: Nikhil's Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Ananya - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Anita - 37 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil walks across the courtyard.]

Anita: "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil claps his hands.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil bursts out laughing.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[Nikhil hurts his knee.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Anita: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Nikhil: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil plays cricket in the park.]

Anita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Anita: "What happened?"

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Anita (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Anita: "Okay, Nikhil."

[Nikhil feeds the birds.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ananya stands in the living room. Nikhil and Anita stand near her.]

Ananya: "Let's begin."

[Ananya puts on red lipstick.]

Ananya: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Nikhil (happily): "Show me too!"

[Nikhil irons his school shirt.]

Nikhil (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil writes in his notebook.]

Nikhil (laughing): "That's easy."

[Nikhil sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Anita: "What a day to remember!"
